Item 1A. Risk Factors
Our customers may reduce orders. Demand for our products is cyclical. A downturn in the economy could reduce our revenue.
We depend on a few suppliers. A supplier failure could delay shipments. Replacing a supplier would take many months.
Our debt limits our flexibility. We must meet covenants under our credit agreement. A breach could make the debt due at once.
Regulation could raise our costs. New environmental rules may apply to our plants. Compliance may require large capital spending.
